# Contributing to MonoGame Documentation

Instructions on how to contribute to the documentation of the MonoGame Framework

Thank you for choosing to contribute to the MonoGame project! This page provides guidance on how you can help to improve the documentation for MonoGame.

## Getting Started

##### Note

If you are new to making contributions to open source projects, it is recommended to understand the following concepts before submitting your contribution:

- [How to fork a repo](https://help.github.com/articles/fork-a-repo/).
- [Creating a new branch for your fork](https://help.github.com/articles/creating-and-deleting-branches-within-your-repository/) from `main`.
- [Creating a new file](https://help.github.com/articles/creating-new-files/) or [editing an existing one](https://help.github.com/articles/editing-files-in-your-repository/) using the GitHub markup editor.
- [How to submit your contributions for review through a pull request](https://help.github.com/articles/creating-a-pull-request/).

### Articles and API References

The MonoGame documentation contains two types of documents: articles and API references.

Articles include manuals, guides, and tutorials on how to use the MonoGame Framework to create games.

API references provide detailed explanation of each class and method found in the MonoGame Framework. The documentation is written in the [C# XML format](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/programming-guide/xmldoc/xml-documentation-comments) and is inline to the MonoGame source code.

### Generating the Documentation Site

The pages for articles and API references are hosted on a documentation site that is generated using [DocFX](https://dotnet.github.io/docfx/).

To generate a local copy of the documentation site:

1. Fork the [docs.monogame.github.io](https://github.com/MonoGame/docs.monogame.github.io) repository.
2. Follow the instructions in the site's [readme](https://github.com/MonoGame/docs.monogame.github.io?tab=readme-ov-file#docsmonogamegithubio) for preparing your environment and generating the documentation.
3. If you intend to make contributions to the API References, then run `git submodule update --init --recursive` command to update the `external/MonoGame` submodule to your local fork.
4. Use the `dotnet docfx docfx.json --serve` command to serve a local copy of the documentation site.
5. Browse the running site from `http://localhost:xxxx`.

##### Tip

Verify your changes in your local documentation site before submitting a pull request with said changes. It is recommended to include screenshots of the pages in the pull request to help reviewers confirm these changes.

## General Rules

The following rules **must** be observed at all times when contributing documentation to the MonoGame project.

- Write in a neutral, technical tone.
- Avoid humor, personal opinions, and colloquial language.
- **Never** plagiarize any documentation from another source.
- Do not use automatic documentation tools as they are ineffective.

##### Warning

Breaking these rules can result in your contribution being rejected.

## General Style Guide

Because there are many contributors to the MonoGame documentation, it can be difficult to maintain a coherent writing style throughout the documentation site. In addition to the General Rules, this style guide serves to inform contributors of the conventions needed to maintain this writing style. So please review the following expectations before contributing any documentation.

### Every Word Should Contain Value

Every word in the reference documentation should provide information beyond the API itself. Documentation that only rehashes or rephrases what is already apparent in the class, method, parameter, or property name has zero value and wastes time for both the writer and reader.

### The First Sentence Is the Most Important

There is no guarantee that the reader will read beyond the first sentence of the reference documentation. This is why that first sentence is the most important and should convey the most key piece of information. Take your time to write the most concise and clear first sentence possible. This helps users tremendously and goes a long way towards having great documentation.

### Surface Information Hidden in the Code

Being inline with the code allows you to easily look for critical information within it that the user might not know from looking at the API alone. Take your time to explore inner method calls and platform specific sections of the code. The time to write the documentation is once you feel you fully understand the code you are documenting. If you don't feel you understand the code then leave the documentation for someone else to write.

### Focus on What Adds Value to the Consumer

Limit documentation to public methods and functions unless there is a specific reason to include internal methods, while documenting internals helps with the readability of the code, it provides limited use to consumers of the MonoGame Framework.

### Documentation Is Referenced Not Read

Remember that the user is searching for an answer for a specific question. It is your job to predict these questions and provide them clear answers.

### Descriptions Should Add Value and Understanding

Describing a thing by naming the thing does not help the developer to understand what the concept is that you are describing, for example:

> "The Genre class provides information about a genre"

Which does not help someone reading the documentation if they do not know what a `Genre` is. Be descriptive and improve the readers understanding for what something is and WHY it is.

## API Reference Style Guide

In addition to the General Style Guide, please consider the following conventions used for code associated with the API reference docs.

By default, the standard [Microsoft recommendations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/xmldoc/recommended-tags) should be used for filling in XML tags for each class, method and property.

With a few points to call out:

#### `<see>` and `<cref/>` should be used whenever an API reference is used in the documentation

To ensure that API documentation is linked to whichever reference is used, `<see>` and `<cref/>` references should be used. This helps users navigate the methods, especially when looking up initializers or use of a property or method.

#### Avoid self referencing `<cref/>` unless it provides value

`<cref/>` blocks are there to add links and create references to other classes, functions and methods that help inform the developer for what those concepts are. Adding a `<cref/>` for the same class or property you are describing just creates a circular reference that does not add value.

References to other methods or properties in the same class is fine, just avoid self if possible.

#### Use descriptors in `<see/>` and `<cref/>` statements for better readability

By default, a `<cref/>` or `<see/>` reference will use only the type you are referencing when rendered to the user, e.g. `<cref="Album.Genre"/>` will render as `Genre`.

Instead, use the descriptor in the style to render what you actually mean, for example: `<cref="Album.Genre">Album.Genre</cref>` which will always render as `Album.Genre` which is much clearer, it is the same for `<see/>` tags.

Comments should be limited to **120** width, with overflow moving to the next line to make reading easier, for example:

```csharp
<summary>
Packed vector type containing unsigned normalized values ranging from 0 to 1. The x and z components use 5 bits,
and the y component uses 6 bits.
</summary>
```

##### Note

If the `cref` description would cause the line to exceed the 120 recommendation, this is generally ok, so long as the rendered line does not exceed the limit. The limit however, is more of a guideline than a hard rule, so common sense should be applied to keep the limit near 120 characters.

To keep the documentation packed and readable, each parameter should be contained to a single line, for example:

```csharp
<summary>
Creates a new instance of Bgr565.
</summary>
<param name="x">The x component</param>
<param name="y">The y component</param>
<param name="z">The z component</param>
```

### Interface Documentation

If documentation is already provided by an interface or inherited class, then the `<inheritdoc />` tag should be used. Critically, **DO NOT** duplicate documentation as it increases maintenance later, for example:

```csharp
/// <inheritdoc />
public void InterfaceDefinedMethod()

/// <inheritdoc cref="IDisposable.Dispose()"/>
public void Dispose()
```

This applies to all derived elements within a class, property or method.

### Inherited Properties

Where a property or type is already documented in an `enum` or `static`, to avoid duplication the `<inheritdoc cref=""/>` style should be used, for example:

```csharp
    public struct VertexPositionColorNormalTexture : IVertexType
    {
        /// <inheritdoc cref="VertexPosition.Position" />
        public Vector3 Position;

        /// <inheritdoc cref="VertexPositionColor.Color" />
        public Color Color;

        /// <inheritdoc cref="VertexPositionNormalTexture.Normal" />
        public Vector3 Normal;

        /// <inheritdoc cref="VertexPositionTexture.Texture" />
        public Vector2 TextureCoordinate;

        /// <inheritdoc cref="IVertexType.VertexDeclaration" />
        public static readonly VertexDeclaration VertexDeclaration;
```

### Protected Methods Requiring Documentation by the Linter

By default, we do not document Finalizers or other protected methods, the recommendation is to apply an empty `<summary />` tag to suppress the warnings raised by the linter, for example:

```csharp
/// <summary />
~Foo() => Dispose(false);
```

## [Prestations familiales : 0,1% de «fraudeurs»](https://www.actuchomage.org/200809244018/Social-economie-et-politique/Prestations-familiales-01-de-fraudeurs.html)

Mercredi, 24 Septembre 2008 14:58

[![Envoyer](https://www.actuchomage.org/templates/ja_teline_ii/images/emailButton.png)](https://www.actuchomage.org/component/option,com_mailto/link,114be8fb07a7970cd504e18ddd12981ba053a9d6/tmpl,component/) [![Imprimer](https://www.actuchomage.org/templates/ja_teline_ii/images/printButton.png)](https://www.actuchomage.org/200809244018/Social-economie-et-politique/Prestations-familiales-01-de-fraudeurs/Imprimer.html)

**«Les fraudes aux allocations familiales explosent !», «Augmentation de 73% des fraudes recensées par la CNAF en 2007 !» : tels sont les titres alarmistes — et sensationnalistes — que l'on peut lire ici et là.**  
Or ce «boom sans précédent» s'explique, tout simplement, par [la montée en puissance des dispositifs de contrôle](https://www.actuchomage.org/modules.php?op=modload&name=News&file=article&sid=3467) avec la mise place d'outils de plus en plus perfectionnés, comme le «répertoire national des bénéficiaires» (RNB) et bientôt, peut-être, [la «sémantique stratégique» ?](https://www.actuchomage.org/modules.php?op=modload&name=News&file=article&sid=3995)  
En réalité, le montant des «fraudes» aux prestations s'élève à 58,4 millions d'euros en 2007, sur un versement total de… 66 milliards. Soit un taux de… 0,1%. En 2006, le préjudice s'était élevé à 35,1 millions sur 64 milliards d’€, soit un taux de fraude de 0,05%.  
Avec un taux de contrôle renforcé à 35%, la CNAF a relevé 6.314 «fraudes» en 2007, contre 3.654 l'année précédente. 62% ont résulté de déclarations d'activités ou de ressources *non à jour* — donc des «indus», qu'on ne peut qualifier de fraude. La fraude avérée résidait, elle, dans les dissimulations de concubinage (24%) et les escroqueries, faux et usage de faux (14%). Sur la base de cette semi-vérité, les trois prestations les plus «fraudées» seraient les aides au logement (30%), le RMI (28%) et l'API (8%).  
Si le taux de contrôle de la CNAF atteignait 100%, on obtiendrait un taux de «fraude» d'environ 0,3% pour un préjudice d'environ 180 millions d'euros. On est très loin des 200 «évadés» français du Liechtenstein qui ont détourné 1 milliard d'euros... Encore plus loin des scores de la fraude fiscale qui représente un manque à gagner de 40 milliards d’€ par an pour les caisses de l'Etat, soit l'équivalent de son déficit public. Mais le gouvernement préfère focaliser sur [la petite fraude aux prestations sociales,](https://www.actuchomage.org/modules.php?op=modload&name=News&file=article&sid=3701) ce qui lui permet de détourner l'attention des Français sur les scandales en col blanc, hautement plus lucratifs et plus discrètement évoqués.

# How Did Harry Potter Survive Voldemort's Second Avada Kedavra?

*It's important to remember the ongoing controversial statements by the creator of the* Harry Potter *franchise. CBR supports the hard work of industry professionals on properties fans know and love and the wider world of* Harry Potter *that fans have adopted as their own. You can find CBR's continuing coverage of Rowling [here](https://www.cbr.com/tag/jk-rowling/).*

It's been years since the main *[Harry Potter](https://www.cbr.com/tag/harry-potter/)* series concluded, but the nostalgia of the saga still spawns theories about some of its most important moments. As every fan knows, Harry survived the killing curse as a baby because his mother's love protected him. However, after Voldemort returned using Harry's blood to regain his full body, he was allowed to touch Harry without suffering negative consequences. This raises the question of how Harry survived the killing curse a *second* time in *Deathly Hallows*.

Being able to touch Harry would, theoretically, mean Voldemort could kill him, hinting that something else was at play. Amid [a few online misconceptions](https://en.m.wikibooks.org/wiki/Muggles%27_Guide_to_Harry_Potter/Books/Deathly_Hallows/Analysis#:~:text=Voldemort%20unwittingly%20makes%20himself%20a,life%2C%20therefore%20Harry%20will%20live), two of the main theories can be discussed and refuted to really understand how it happened. The first is that the Resurrection Stone brought Harry back after Voldemort cast Avada Kedavra. The second is that when Voldemort restored his body using Harry's blood in *The Goblet of Fire*, he became a Horcrux of Harry. However, these theories are easy to refute, or at least challenge, and the true explanation is much more straightforward.

***Updated on May 15, 2025, by Andrea Sandoval:** Harry's survival of the Killing Curse not once but twice might be his most considerable feat. We updated this article to discuss further how Harry Potter might have died in Deathly Hallows, even if it was briefly.*

## Harry Came Back to Life After Being Hit By Voldemort's Killing Curse (A Second Time)

### Harry's Self-Sacrifice Was a Gamble, as Not Even Dumbledore Fully Understood the Nature of Horcruxes

When Harry discovers he's one of Lord Voldemort's Horcruxes [through Severus Snape's memories](http://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-movies-snape-scenes-left-out/), he understands that he needs to die for his peers to be able to kill the Dark Lord once and for all. Since Voldemort was waiting for Harry to turn himself in, the Boy Who Lived decided to allow the villain to finally kill him. Voldemort, predictably, uses the Avada Kedavra on Harry for a second time, and thinking him dead, makes Hagrid take his body to Hogwarts to celebrate his victory.

##### [10 Wild Harry Potter Plot Twists That Completely Changed the Franchise](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-plot-twists-changed-everything/)

Harry Potter's magical journey was made even more exciting by the shocking plot twists that finally explained every detail in the series.

However, after a brief interaction in his head with Albus Dumbledore in King's Cross Station, **Harry returns to life, to the surprise of not only his friends but Lord Voldemort himself**. This moment, which isn't as widely explained in the film as in the books, confuses many fans who don't fully understand how Harry could return from the killing curse. The explanation has to do with the logistics of Horcruxes, which not even Dumbledore, one of the brightest wizards ever born, fully understood, as he wasn't sure Harry would survive the killing curse for a second time. But he did.

## Harry's Survival Had Nothing to Do With the Resurrection Stone

### The Resurrection Stone's Ability to Bring the Dead Back Isn't That Simple

Many *Harry Potter* fans have speculated that [the Resurrection Stone's power](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-overpowered-magical-objects/) was able to help Harry survive the killing curse and return to living status. Except, that's not how the Resurrection Stone works. While it can "recall loved ones from the grave," **the *Harry Potter* universe's Resurrection Stone cannot fully restore someone to life**. As told in "The Tale of the Three Brothers," the Resurrection Stone brought the second brother's loved one back to the living world, but because she didn't belong there, she soon turned cold and sad.

The theory about Harry's survival was connected to his use of the Stone before his encounter with Voldemort in the Forbidden Forest. Recovering the Stone from the Golden Snitch, Harry recalled his mother and the Marauders for emotional support and then dropped it to the ground. As shown, he could see and hear his dead loved ones, but they remained incorporeal, and no one else could perceive them. Thus, bringing Harry back to life doesn't appear to be within the Stone's power.

## Why Voldemort Wasn't a Horcrux for Harry

### Horcruxes May Be a Mystery, But Fans Know Enough About Them to Recognize This Isn't Possible

Nobody knows exactly how [Horcruxes are made in *Harry Potter*](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-how-voldemort-horcruxes-destroyed/), as that information has never been fully divulged. While Voldemort used Harry's blood to regain his full body with dark magic, he could have become a Horcrux, of sorts. But the theory has some holes. To begin with, a Horcrux is connected to someone's soul, not their blood. Furthermore, to create a Horcrux, one has to first split one's soul by murdering someone, and Harry Potter never murdered anyone.

The killing curse is the worst spell a wizard can cast on another, and Voldemort creates Horcruxes by killing and storing pieces of his soul in objects and other living beings. Because **Harry did not kill anyone, he could not have made a Horcrux out of Voldemort**. Taking Harry's blood allowed Voldemort to negate the effects of Lily's protection over Harry and strengthened their connection, but unless a person's soul is in their blood, this would not make Voldemort a Horcrux.

##### [10 Weirdest Details About the Horcruxes in Harry Potter](https://www.cbr.com/weirdest-horcrux-details-harry-potter/)

The Harry Potter franchise took on a darker tone with the debut of Horcruxes, and even now, weird details prove how scary they can be.

Furthermore, [if Voldemort had been Harry's Horcrux](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-horcruxes-facts/), Harry still wouldn't have come back to life in his original body. His soul would have been wandering until he had found a way to create a body of his own. When everyone thought Voldemort had died after the Avada Kedavra he aimed at baby Harry bounced back to him, he spent several years living as a sort of spirit and had to become a parasite in Quirinus Quirrell's body for a while.

## So, How Did Harry Potter Survive the Second Killing Curse?

### Voldemort's Killing Curse Struck the Remaining Piece of His Own Fractured Soul

The matter of surviving a killing curse is a full-circle moment for *Harry Potter*. By trying to kill him the first time, Voldemort bonds himself to Harry forever, with a small piece of his soul living inside him and marked by the scar. It explained [why Harry was able to speak Parseltongue](https://www.cbr.com/why-harry-potter-communicate-with-snakes/). Dumbledore was one of the few to realize this when he and Harry discovered that Voldemort had been using Horcruxes to cheat death in *The* *Half-Blood Prince*. Therefore, being one of the Horcruxes and a piece of his soul, Harry had to die to defeat evil — and as the unwitting creator, Voldemort himself would have to do it.

But Harry didn't die, and the reason is rather simple: **when Voldemort cast the killing curse, it only killed the piece of his soul within Harry, not Harry himself**. Ironically, this isn't the first time Voldemort's connection with Harry gave Harry the tools to avoid The Dark Lord's attacks. In this case, Harry survived Voldemort's curse because the villain had implanted a piece of his soul inside the young man, inadvertently creating a Horcrux.

##### [Harry Potter Theory: The Deathly Hallows Kept Harry From Being Killed](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-theory-deathly-hallows-kept-harry-alive/)

A fan theory speculates that the Deathly Hallows may have protected Harry Potter from Lord Voldemort's second attempt at killing him.

This Horcrux also helped Harry during his second year at Hogwarts, when he could speak Parseltongue and get to the Chamber of Secrets to save Ginny Weasley. What's more, this connection allowed Harry to see things inside Voldemort's head and save Arthur Weasley's life. **By accidentally making Harry a Horcrux, Voldemort helps him time and time again, including enabling Harry to survive the Killing Curse** for the second time.

## What Does the Limbo Scene Represent in Harry Potter

### Harry Chooses Between Heading to the Afterlife or Coming Back to Life

After Voldemort casts a second killing curse on Harry Potter, the Boy Who Lived is sent to some sort of limbo in *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2*. There, Harry sees Dumbledore in a version of King's Cross station, something that Dumbledore said was probably happening in his head. He also said that Harry could probably board a train if he wanted to, which presumably would've taken him to the afterlife.

What is curious about Harry seeing King's Cross station appearing in limbo is that **the real King's Cross station is itself a limbo between the Muggles and the Wizarding Worlds.** For Harry, the station has always been the place that separates his mundane reality in Little Whinging from the magic of Hogwarts. *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2* implies that limbo appears differently for every person. In life, the Hogwarts Express meant to Harry everything he ever cared for — his friends, his dreams, his future. There's a beautiful symbology behind Harry taking this same train to reach the afterlife, but this time, he must head in the opposite direction.

##### [This Harry Potter Scene is Key to the Franchise's Finale](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-scene-key-to-franchises-finale/)

The Harry Potter franchise has many important scenes that define the character, but only one scene defines the entire finale.

The big mystery surrounding the limbo scene from *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2* involves Dumbledore. Fans debate to this day whether Harry's soul truly encountered Dumbledore's or the Hogwarts headmaster's apparition was simply the fruit of Harry's imagination, as in a conversation with himself. It is a reasonable theory, but it's well known that when a wizard dies, they can choose between moving on or returning as a ghost. The second option often relates to unfinished business or fear of the afterlife. Presumably, limbo is where they make this choice, meaning that Dumbledore could've been waiting for Harry since he fell from the Astronomy Tower.

As for [the bloody Voldemort baby Harry sees in limbo](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-scene-key-to-franchises-finale/), there's a more straightforward explanation: **since Voldemort only killed the piece of his soul stored within Harry, the baby represents this fragment of Voldemort's soul that was shredded by the villain's killing curse.** It seems like this second near-death experience brought Harry into limbo, but ultimately, Harry survived the curse. Harry Potter then decided to return to life to stop Voldemort. As such, perhaps Harry could've died at this moment, but he chose to come back to life.

## Harry Was Also Saved By Draco Malfoy's Mother, Narcissa

### Draco's Mother Saved Harry's Soul, But His Community Helped Him Survive Afterward

Harry comes back to life after Voldemort's second killing curse thanks to the Horcrux inside of him, his mother's sacrifice, and Voldemort's hubris. However, if it wasn't for Narcissa Malfoy, it is unlikely — although never impossible when it comes to the Wizarding Word — that Harry would have survived a third Avada Kedavra. He was, after all, surrounded by Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters, with no way to escape.

In the books, [Lord Voldemort orders Narcissa Malfoy](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-death-eater-identities-explained/) to check if the Boy Who Lived has finally died, and in the movies, it is Bellatrix who asks her sister. Either way, in both versions, Narcissa gets close to Harry and checks his pulse. She notices Harry is alive, but she lies to Lord Voldemort, one of the most difficult things to do. Narcissa could have died if Voldemort had simply used legilimency on her. But once again, **Voldemort underestimated the strength of a person he considered weak and powerless**. He never saw Narcissa Malfoy lying to him, so Narcissa's one moment of goodness — out of worry about her own son, Draco — and Voldemort's great ego also played a role in Harry's survival.

What's more, it is interesting to consider that Voldemort sent someone else to check if Harry was alive. Voldemort went to war against the most powerful wizards and witches in magical society only to kill Harry Potter. He considered Harry his biggest threat from the moment he read the prophecy. At the same time, however, Voldemort considered himself above Harry's powers — and he was right. But when it came to checking Harry's pulse, Voldemort preferred another person to get close to him, instead of making sure for himself that [the Chosen One was finally dead](https://www.cbr.com/best-movies-chosen-one-trope/). Arguably, Voldemort was, in fact, afraid of Harry. Ultimately, Voldemort's fear led him to his death and destruction, much like his fear led him to create Harry as his antagonist.

## Did Harry Potter Die in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows?

### Harry Might Have Died For a Couple of Minutes, But Eventually Came Back To Life

While Harry survived the second killing curse Voldemort sent his way, the question remains whether he died even for a second and came back to life or had just passed out. The first time Voldemort [cast Avada Kedavra](https://www.cbr.com/what-avada-kedavra-mean-harry-potter/) against Harry, the curse didn't truly touch him. The magical impact left a mark on Harry, which might also be a product of Voldemort's soul entering his body as he unknowingly turned him into a Horcrux. However, Harry was never in danger.

**The second time the killing curse hits Harry, it is very different because it does impact the Boy Who Lived**. This time, it doesn't leave a mark (which might further confirm that Harry's scar comes from being a Horcrux and not from Avada Kedavra), but Harry at least passes out and has a spiritual experience. The Dumbledore in Harry's head (whether real or not) suggests that, since Harry was at a train station, free to choose his path, he could have decided to die or return. This is evidence that even though the Unforgivable Curse hit Voldemort's soul and not Harry's, the curse affected Harry's body this time.

##### [10 Saddest Harry Potter Scenes You Have to Mentally Prepare For](https://www.cbr.com/saddest-harry-potter-scenes/)

The Harry Potter movies are filled with fun and action but are also home to some of the saddest scenes imaginable.

If Harry was in a limbo space, choosing his next step and meeting a part of Dumbledore's soul, this could mean that his soul was outside his body. Harry had the choice of moving his soul back to his body, moving it to the afterlife, or maybe even becoming a ghost. If this scenario is true, Harry did die for a couple of minutes, up until the moment his soul presumably returns to his body and he comes back to life.

On the other hand, if Harry had imagined the whole situation, it would have meant he had been alive all that time. The impact of the Killing Curse on his body could have made him pass out, and he processed the moment through a dream. However, based on how vivid the limbo moment seems to be, the coherency of Dumbledore's voice, and [the concrete image of Voldemort's soul](https://www.cbr.com/harry-potter-theory-horcrux-plot-hole/), one could argue that Harry was truly in a limbo space, which would mean Harry Potter died in *Deathly Hallows*—but came back to life.

# Гороскоп Таро на 21 квітня: що чекає на ваш знак

21 квітня 2025 року карти Таро дають своєрідний прогноз для кожного знака зодіаку. Цей день буде сповнений важливих подій, як на особистому фронті, так і в професійному житті. Залежно від вашого знака, вам варто звернути увагу на певні аспекти: чи то активність, чи то концентрація на меті, чи навіть розслаблення в любові та роботі. У нашій статті ми розглянемо, який гороскоп по картах Таро підготував 21 квітня для всіх знаків зодіаку.

## **ОВЕН (21 березня - 20 квітня): Зірка**

Карти Таро для Овнів на 21 квітня пророкують, що день буде удачливим. В особистих стосунках рекомендується проявити любов і увагу, а на роботі варто розслабитися і не перенапружуватися. Зірка символізує гармонію, тому Овнам можна дозволити собі насолоджуватися результатами своєї роботи та стосунками без зайвих турбот.

## **ТЕЛЕЦЬ (21 квітня - 21 травня): Лицар жезлів**

Для Тільців 21 квітня буде часом активних дій. У стосунках важливо проявити ініціативу і рухатися вперед. Карта Лицаря жезлів вказує на те, що Тільці можуть досягти нових вершин, якщо не зупинятимуться на досягнутому. На кар'єрному шляху також не варто стояти на місці — рухайтеся вперед.

## **БЛИЗНЯТА (22 травня - 21 червня): Лицар пентаклів**

Близнятам варто сконцентруватися на своїх цілях. Карта Лицаря пентаклів підказує, що цей день важливий для роздумів. В особистих стосунках важливо знайти спільну мету для розвитку, а на роботі — визначитися з напрямком і прагнути досягти бажаного.

## **РАК (22 червня - 22 липня): Дев'ятка пентаклів**

Для Раків цей день принесе відчуття досягнутого успіху. В особистих стосунках варто дозволити партнеру проявити ініціативу. На роботі все йде добре, але не забувайте про відпочинок і підтримку близьких. Дев'ятка пентаклів означає задоволення від результатів.

## **ЛЕВ (23 липня - 23 серпня): Сонце**

Левам у цей день світить Сонце. Це карта радості та успіху, яка вказує на те, що стосунки будуть теплими і гармонійними. Леви можуть діяти активно на роботі, і це принесе їм позитивні результати. Тому цей день — чудовий для нових починань.

## **ДІВА (24 серпня - 23 вересня): П'ятірка мечів**

Для Дів на 21 квітня карта П'ятірка мечів попереджає про можливі конфлікти та розчарування, особливо в особистих стосунках. На роботі намагайтеся тримати емоції під контролем і не виявляти своїх внутрішніх переживань. Зберігайте спокій, щоб уникнути непотрібних проблем.

## **ТЕРЕЗИ (24 вересня - 23 жовтня): Десятка жезлів**

Терезам варто звернути увагу на те, що вони самі можуть створювати собі проблеми. У стосунках та на роботі з'являться нові виклики, які потребують рішучих дій. Десятка жезлів вказує на важливість подолання труднощів, не дозволяючи їм стати на шляху до успіху.

## **СКОРПІОН (23 жовтня - 22 листопада): Король жезлів**

Скорпіони повинні проявити свій характер і лідерські якості. Карта Короля жезлів вказує на важливість рішучості в любові та на роботі. Ваш професіоналізм і харизма допоможуть вам досягти нових вершин.

## **СТРІЛЕЦЬ (23 листопада - 22 грудня): Паж пентаклів**

Для Стрільців 21 квітня принесе нові можливості. Паж пентаклів у гороскопі Таро говорить про те, що цей день — хороший для нових починань, особливо у стосунках і кар'єрі. Будьте відкриті до нових ідей та можливостей, які можуть з'явитися на горизонті.

## **КОЗОРІГ (23 грудня - 20 січня): Дев'ятка кубків**

Для Козорогів цей день — знак досягнутого успіху та задоволення від того, що було зроблено. Дев'ятка кубків вказує на гармонію у стосунках, але на роботі можуть з'явитися нові випробування. Постарайтеся знайти баланс між особистим і професійним життям.

## **ВОДОЛІЙ (21 січня - 20 лютого): Колісниця**

Водолії отримають можливість змін. Карта Колісниці вказує на час для рішучих дій і нових ініціатив. В стосунках важливо зробити крок вперед, а на роботі вас можуть чекати нові відрядження або подорожі.

## **РИБИ (21 лютого - 20 березня): Колесо Фортуни**

Риби будуть свідками змін. Колесо Фортуни показує, що все змінюється, і сьогодні для Риб буде день переміни. У стосунках рухайтеся вперед до спільної мети, а на роботі подумайте про резервні варіанти, якщо щось піде не так.

21 квітня обіцяє бути насиченим для кожного знака зодіаку. Карти Таро показують, що для одних це день активних дій і нових можливостей, а для інших — час для самороздумів та визначення важливих цілей. Залежно від вашого знака, гороскоп може підказати вам, як діяти для досягнення бажаних результатів.

Although spider veins don’t pose any health issues, you may want to remove them for cosmetic reasons. Sclerotherapy is the most popular treatment for spider veins, but laser therapy is another effective way to remove them.

Spider veins, or telangiectasias, are visible, tiny blood vessels mostly found in your legs.

Laser treatment for [spider veins](https://www.healthline.com/health/varicose-veins) involves targeting the vein directly with a beam of light, which causes blood clots to form that block off and destroy the veins. Laser therapy is the [second most](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6483333) popular option to treat spider veins.

In some cases, a combination of laser treatment and sclerotherapy may be best to remove veins completely. Here’s what to know.

There are a few types of laser treatment for spider veins:

- **Surface laser therapy:** This type is often used to break down larger varicose veins, but it can also be used to treat spider veins. With this approach, your skin will be heated and cooled simultaneously to prevent burning.
- **Endovenous laser therapy (EVLT):** EVLT is a newer approach that involves inserting a laser probe straight into the affected blood vessel. The intense heat breaks down the vessel internally. Since it’s more invasive, this method requires local anesthetic.
- **Intense pulsed light (IPL) therapy:** While IPL isn’t technically considered laser therapy, its use of intense light makes it very similar to laser therapy. It works by targeting direct light to the vessels outside the skin.

There are also several types of lasers used to treat spider veins, including:

- **Argon lasers:** These were one of the first used to treat spider and varicose veins, but they carry a higher risk of causing scarring and discoloration than other laser types.
- **Pulsed dye lasers:** This type of laser is particularly useful for treating smaller spider veins. Due to their shorter pulses and integrated cooling device, they carry a lower risk of unintended burning, heat damage, and scarring.
- **Pulsed diode lasers:** Like pulsed dye lasers, these have an integrated cooling device, making them less likely to cause burns or scarring. They also cause minimal inflammation compared with other types and are less likely to cause hyperpigmentation on darker skin.
- **Neodymium YAG (Nd:YAG) lasers:** This type is particularly effective for spider veins but tends to cause more pain and discomfort than other lasers. Like pulsed diode lasers, Nd:YAG lasers are less likely to cause hyperpigmentation on darker skin.
- **Potassium-titanyl-phosphate lasers:** This type has a limited penetration range, so it’s typically used on smaller areas, such as the face.

Before getting laser therapy, talk with a dermatologist about which type will be most effective for your needs. In some cases, they may recommend combining laser therapy with [sclerotherapy](https://www.healthline.com/health/sclerotherapy) or another vein removal method.

Once you have a plan in place, they’ll walk through your health history, lifestyle habits, allergies, and any medications and supplements you may be taking. Be sure to mention if you have a history of bleeding disorders or if you take any blood thinners.

If you’re getting EVLT with anesthetic, you might be asked to avoid eating or drinking for at least [8 hours](https://www.hopkinsmedicine.org/health/treatment-tests-and-therapies/endovenous-laser-varicose-vein-surgery) before the procedure. You also may need to plan to have someone drive you home.

Depending on the procedure, you may be given a light sedative beforehand.

After laser treatment, you can typically resume your normal day-to-day activities almost immediately.

To soothe any pain or discomfort and aid in your recovery, your clinician may recommend:

- using a cool compress to reduce swelling
- keeping incision sites (if undergoing EVLT) out of water for at least 48 hours
- avoiding sitting or lying down for long periods of time
- keeping your legs elevated when sitting or lying down
- not standing for long periods without moving
- walking regularly several times a day
- avoiding hot baths for a couple weeks
- taking over-the-counter (OTC) pain medication as needed
- stopping taking blood thinning medication until your doctor says you can resume it
- heading to follow-up appointments as needed

If you had laser treatment for spider veins on your legs, you may also be instructed to:

- wear compression stockings for a few days or weeks
- avoid sitting or lying down for long periods
- keep your legs elevated when sitting or lying down
- not stand for long periods without moving
- walk at regular intervals throughout the day

Depending on what type of laser treatment you get and the size of your veins, results may appear right away.

EVLT results may take longer, though. The veins may die off and disintegrate within several months to a year. But EVLT typically requires fewer sessions than other methods (in many cases, a single treatment is effective).

Laser treatment is most effective for smaller, delicate spider veins, such as those on your face.

Larger spider veins, such as those on your legs, may be difficult to remove with lasers alone. That’s because to eliminate the veins altogether, the “feeder vein” or origin vein must be eliminated, which can be trickier to target in the lower extremities.

But even for small veins on the face, you’ll likely need multiple laser treatment sessions to remove them completely (unless you get EVLT).

While the results of laser therapy are permanent, new spider veins may appear in the area.

### Laser treatment vs. sclerotherapy

While laser treatment for spider veins continues to improve, sclerotherapy is still the gold-standard treatment for spider veins because it:

- typically costs less
- causes less pain
- tends to produce better results more quickly

Still, laser therapy may still be ideal for those who:

- want to avoid needles
- are allergic to sclerosant
- have capillary matting, which resembles bruising around the veins
- have veins that are too small to be injected via sclerotherapy

Again, depending on the severity of your spider veins, a combination of both laser treatment and sclerotherapy may be most effective.

In general, lasers are a safe and effective way to treat spider veins. Aside from EVLT, laser treatment is noninvasive and requires minimal recovery time.

But like any procedure, laser therapy involves a risk of side effects, including:

- blistering
- crusting
- swelling
- spotting
- infection
- pain
- bleeding
- nerve damage
- blood clots
- changes in skin color
- burns

Working with a qualified dermatologist who has experience working with your skin type can help to minimize your risk of side effects.

### Is it painful?

Laser treatment is somewhat painful. Keep in mind that topical anesthetic is only minimally effective at reducing pain from laser treatment. If you’re concerned about pain, talk with a dermatologist about any additional pain-relieving steps you can take beforehand.

### Will I need multiple treatments?

Many people experience significant improvements with one laser treatment. But to fully remove spider veins, you may need up to five or six sessions. The larger the spider vein, the more treatments you’ll likely need.

### How long do results last?

Results are technically permanent as long as the “feeder vein” or origin vein is removed. This doesn’t prevent new spider veins from appearing in the future.

### How much does it cost?

According to [The American Society of Plastic Surgeons](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/cosmetic-procedures/spider-vein-treatment/cost), one session of laser treatment in the United States costs about $300, though specific costs can vary widely by location.

Laser treatment is an effective method to treat and remove spider veins. It’s second only to sclerotherapy in terms of popularity and effectiveness. After the veins are targeted via laser light, they’ll break down and disintegrate over the course of several weeks.

# How Valentine, Head of Marketing at Fleet, Uses Dust

![Fleet logo](https://images.ctfassets.net/751ge4ljeqso/Rj7y7rEVX4PXEM3veabPR/2ffdac13a01d3240b8595fd369006072/image.png?w=3840&fm=webp&q=75)

![Valentine Chelius](https://images.ctfassets.net/751ge4ljeqso/dwrd0G5VtsF8dEvH01B0c/cc67023f9dbd9b4f3a7cfdbee89d6aa3/image.png?w=3840&fm=webp&q=75)

Valentine Chelius

*Founded in 2019, Fleet is a unique IT equipment management company enabling users to rent, manage, secure, and renew their entire IT device fleet from a single platform.*

*Earlier this year Fleet added a fresh face to their team, taking on SEO specialist Valentine Chelius as their new Head of Marketing. Coming from several years working exclusively in SEO, Valentine faced the challenge of rapidly adjusting to a significantly broader role at Fleet. At the time of her hiring, Fleet’s marketing team was decidedly small. All at once, she became responsible for creating new internal structures in addition to keeping up with various ongoing marketing tasks.*

*How could Valentine master all aspects of her expansive new role while facing the constraints of limited support and critical deadlines? These demands led Valentine to search for a solution that could help her to create diverse on-brand content and learn essential new skills for her role.*

*Fleet is an IT equipment management solution for businesses that provides streamlined leasing of computers and office technology. The company aims to offer a unique solution for computer and device acquisition for startups and SMEs. From a single platform, users can rent, manage, secure, and renew their entire IT device fleet. Since its establishment, Fleet has simplified the process of acquiring and managing office technology leases for over 1000 companies globally, which includes startups, agencies, SMEs, schools, and more.*

### Valentine embraced a new role but felt overwhelmed by the wide-ranging responsibilities.

Prior to joining Fleet, Valentine spent four years working at Aircall as Global SEO Manager before shifting to PayFit to serve as their Global SEO Lead. After spending more than five years deepening her specialization in SEO, Valentine pivoted away from SEO to join Fleet as Head of Marketing.

In her new role at Fleet, Valentine courageously took on a plethora of new tasks and responsibilities that pushed her beyond her scope of expertise and into the multifaceted world of marketing.

As anyone who’s worked in marketing could tell you, **the responsibilities of a marketing lead are extraordinarily wide-ranging.** Valentine’s new role at Fleet covered digital acquisition, branding, visual identity, partnerships, tracking and performance, SEO and SEA, newsletters, and all forms of external communications. In other words, Valentine would have to become a jack of all trades almost overnight.

Stepping into this new role, Valentine was tasked with taking charge of ongoing deliverables and communications while setting up her new role's structural framework. Not only was she being challenged **to quickly master various unfamiliar tasks**, but she also faced the **obstacle of being supported by a notably small team, comprising two temporary interns**. Understandably, the bulk of long-term marketing responsibilities were placed on Valentine’s shoulders.

Faced with this daunting scenario, Valentine enlisted the help of Dust, an AI platform she discovered during her previous role.

### How Dust Empowered Valentine as Fleet’s Head of Marketing

#### Learning new software

Dust served as Valentine's lifeline when it came to learning new software like the CRM platform HubSpot.

While Valentine had no previous experience with HubSpot, a CRM software, she needed to **dive deeply into the software to fulfill her role**. HubSpot can require some dedicated online study in order to be fully mastered, and it’s typically easier to use for those who are familiar with CSS.

While she initially found the CRM quite complicated, she gained understanding and familiarity by asking Dust questions such as how to go about creating a report, which field to use, and how to clean data.

> *“I was just curious to start with, and then curiosity turns into a necessity because of very [short timelines]. So I had to learn fast and couldn’t do half of my job without [Dust].”*

#### Leveraging internal data to draft content and ensure pitch-perfect branding

Valentine utilized Dust’s potential to make the most of the time she spent on external communications. Dust turned out to be a major help in writing content for newsletters and other brand assets. Thanks to Dust’s ability to retrieve data from existing Fleet sources and use it to generate **an initial draft**, Valentine had **a strong starting point** for creating content that aligned with Fleet’s brand guidelines and tone of voice. For example, although she had never written a press release previously, Valentine created a solid press release in accordance with PR best practices with the help of Dust.

Another trick that helps to ensure harmonious and on-brand content at Fleet is Valentine’s custom curated data source or **“brand checker.”** She created a “brand checker” data source by inputting Fleet’s on-brand messaging and tone of voice into a Dust folder, which can then be plugged into any new Dust agent or task. This versatile data source set has enabled Valentine and her team to create content with consistent messaging and tone of voice.

#### Creating a custom Dust agent to streamline external communications

Additionally, Valentine has created a key custom Dust agent Valentine for her day-to-day use in content creation. This is an **SEO Manager Agent for content creation**.

1. She created this agent by starting with SEMrush keyword data and asking the agent to **create topic clusters** and provide **search intent**.
2. From there, Valentine **selects queries to focus on** and **requests a content brief structure**. The agent then provides several options for meta tags, headings, key points, and internal links.
3. After iterations and once the brief is finalized, Valentine and her team move on to writing.

The agent has access to company folders including the “brand checker” that maintain **consistent tone** and **product information throughout the process**. Although the content is initially AI-written, the team remains closely involved, reviewing and adapting the text to ensure quality and accuracy. This has been a huge time saver for Valentine’s team given their small size and tight deadlines.

Furthermore, Valentine uses Dust’s prompt coach template to create instructions for her custom agents. She also uses agents to check some technical SEO recommendations before sending them to Fleet’s development team.

Valentine’s advice on when to create an agent:

> *“I would say–create agents when you have recurring tasks. And also when you have…big one-shot things you don't know, like a video script, like a press release, like how to come up with a complex dashboard. So I would say that the two use cases are recurring tasks and new things.”*

**Getting access to multiple LLMs in one place for the highest-quality content :** *A critical feature of Dust that led Valentine to implement it into her role at Fleet is that it provides access to several LLMs in one place without the need to juggle multiple subscriptions. Of these LLMs, Valentine personally prefers to use Claude most for its formatting, tone, and relevance of answers.*

#### Conquering new creative tasks:

Valentine’s proudest Dust-empowered moment so far has been creating **a video script**, something she had never done before and had to deliver on a very short deadline.

> *“I would say that was completely new ground for me…The process was great and something that I hadn’t done before. So I’m quite proud that I discovered [how to do] this, and even the freelancers thought the script was good.”*

#### Improving the efficiency of translations within a global company

Due to her fruitful and effective use of Dust within the scope of marketing, Valentine became a strong advocate for integrating Dust into other tasks at her company.

Beyond Valentine’s role in marketing, she has also **encouraged the integration of Dust into other teams, improving collaboration and efficiency more broadly at Fleet**. This has been particularly true in the realm of **translation**.

Dust has allowed Fleet teams **to cut translation times by generating translations that require Fleet’s local teams to simply proofread rather than create them from scratch**. This prevents a long back-and-forth between internationally located teams, saving time and boosting efficiency at this globalized company.

According to Valentine, Dust has successfully eliminated the translation bottleneck at Fleet.

#### Excited about Dust’s possible future applications at Fleet

Looking to the future, Valentine is particularly excited **about Vision–Dust’s new image analysis tool**, which blew her away with the accuracy of its generated image descriptions. She envisions future uses for Fleet’s website accessibility that could be highly time-saving.

Through her bold experiments utilizing Dust to overcome the challenge of accomplishing new, diverse tasks with limited support, Valentine got the impression that using Dust offers some of the same benefits as acquiring additional team support.

> *“I would say [Dust] could be like an extension of your team. It could be as useful, as fast, as polite. I’m surprised by the human-like tone of the conversation. It doesn’t feel like you’re talking to a bot.”*

Overall, Valentine’s experiences with Dust in her lead marketing role **exemplify AI’s ability to help people adapt to challenging work constraints, including unfamiliar tasks and limited support**.

Thanks to Dust, Valentine gained a sense of pride by achieving new milestones in her career, even accomplishing feats that seemed impossible to her in the past. Because of Dust’s accessibility, Valentine was able to use AI to simplify and empower her own workflow and even encourage its adoption by other teams, bringing greater efficiency to her company overall.

**Dust empowers you to do anything:**

> *“You have access to anything. You can be a developer, a designer, a scriptwriter, or anything else as long as you are willing to know about it. There are no limits.”*

# Seminare

## Ladungsicherung

Die Ladungssicherung von Waren ist aus zweierlei Gründen wünschenswert: zum einen soll die **Ware in einwandfreiem Zustand** bei den Empfänger:innen eintreffen, zum anderen ist auf die **Sicherheitsbedürfnisse des Transporteurs** Rücksicht zu nehmen. Bei der Beförderung von Gefahrgut müssen zusätzlich **haftungsrechtliche Aspekte** beachtet werden.

## Gefahrgutfahrer/ -innen

Transportvolumen und wirtschaftliche Bedeutung im Bereich Gefahrgut haben in den letzten Jahren stark zugenommen. Fahrer:innen, die sich für die in den Vorschriften definierten Gefahr-Guttransporte weiterqualifizieren möchten, benötigen eine Schulung. Nach bestandener Prüfung erhalten sie eine auf fünf Jahre befristete ADR-Bescheinigung.

## Ladekran

Die Anforderungen an Kraftfahrer/innen im Gütertransport sind stetig gestiegen, so dass allein der Besitz der Fahrerlaubnis zur Ausübung des Berufs nicht mehr ausreicht. Der Umgang mit einem Ladekran verlangt Können, Geschick und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

## Gabelstapler

Der Gabelstapler Führerschein, auch als Flurförderzeugführerschein bezeichnet, ermöglicht es Ihnen, Gabelstapler und andere Flurförderzeuge sicher zu bedienen.

## ASF – Aufbauseminar

Das **Aufbauseminar ASF** (früher Führerschein auf Probe-FaP) wird bei **Verstößen während der Probezeit angeordne**t. Dazu wird eine bestimmte Frist gesetzt. Wer bis dahin **beim Amt keine gültige Teilnahmebescheinigung vorlegt**, bekommt den **Führerschein** solange **eingezogen**, bis er diese nachreicht.

## Fahreignungsseminar

Das **Fahreignungsseminar ersetzt** im Rahmen des Fahreignungsregisters (FAER) **das bisherige Aufbauseminar**, das nur von Fahrlehrer:innen durchgeführt wird.

# 11 UK Food Distributors and How to Choose the Right Partner

Compare 11 UK food distributors and wholesalers by channel, coverage and category fit, and see which publish a supplier route.

## Key takeaways

- The 11 companies form a shortlist across foodservice and independent retail; their numbering is not a revenue or quality ranking.
- Match the route to the product: broadline foodservice, independent-retail wholesale and regional delivery need different packs, economics and launch evidence.
- Confirm delivery postcodes, category buyer and stock-owning role; national coverage does not establish access to every account.
- Distinguish a public supplier intake route from an existing-supplier marketing hub, and verify routes that are not publicly documented.
- Agree selling effort, launch measures and review or exit terms before granting wide exclusivity.

If you are choosing a UK food or beverage distributor, start with channel fit rather than company size. Bidfood and Brakes are national delivered wholesalers; Bestway and Booker combine wholesale routes for independent retail and foodservice; the remaining companies add regional or channel-specific foodservice depth. These 11 companies are a practical shortlist of potential channel partners, not a revenue ranking. Many operate primarily as wholesalers, so confirm whether each candidate will simply stock and deliver your product or actively represent it to named accounts. Availability, listing criteria and delivery coverage change, so verify them directly before committing stock or exclusivity.

For the channel, import and launch decisions behind the shortlist, start with our [UK market-entry plan](https://www.gourmetpro.co/markets/united-kingdom/).

## How We Chose Our Top UK Food Distributors

We assessed the companies by the channel they serve, stated delivery territory, product breadth or specialism, and whether a manufacturer can identify a public supplier route. We checked company websites on 14 September 2026 and removed unsupported revenue, depot-count and interview claims. “Top” here means useful companies to investigate across different routes to market. It does not mean that number 1 is objectively larger or better than number 11.

The list is a starting point rather than a complete UK directory. To find more regional or specialist wholesalers, use the current [Food & Drink Wholesale UK member list](https://www.fwd.co.uk/members), the [Country Range Group member list](https://countryrangegroup.com/our-members/) and the filters described by the [YF wholesaler search tool](https://weareyf.com/wholesaler-search-tool/). A trade-body membership, buying-group listing or directory result is only a lead: verify the legal counterparty, stock-owning role, delivery territory, category buyer and appetite for new products directly.

Before approaching any distributor, prepare a UK-ready trade pack with wholesale price, recommended retail price, case size, shelf life, storage temperature, allergen and nutrition data, current certifications, production capacity, launch support and target accounts. A broadliner may expect proven foodservice demand, while a specialist or regional distributor may accept a narrower launch if the category case is strong.

## Our List of The Top 11 UK Food Distributors

### 1. Bidfood UK

[Bidfood UK](https://www.bidfood.co.uk/) describes itself as a national food, drink and catering-supplies wholesaler serving hospitality, education, healthcare and other out-of-home customers through 26 UK sites. It suits manufacturers with foodservice-ready pack formats, dependable production and a clear category proposition. Its official [supplier route](https://www.bidfood.co.uk/get-in-touch/bidfood-companies/) directs prospective suppliers to basic requirements and a pre-supply checklist; confirm which depot or national category buyer owns your category.

### 2. Brakes

[Brakes](https://www.brake.co.uk/about-us) is a Sysco company and a national delivered wholesaler for catering and out-of-home customers. Its range spans fresh, ambient and frozen food as well as equipment, with specialist businesses inside the wider Sysco GB portfolio. Brakes publishes a direct [supplier registration route](https://www.brake.co.uk/supplier-information-and-isupply) and says potential suppliers must meet its quality and responsible-sourcing standards.

### 3. Bestway Wholesale

[Bestway Wholesale](https://www.bestwaywholesale.co.uk/) connects brands with independent convenience retail, licensed trade and foodservice customers through several wholesale services. Its published depot and delivery figures describe different parts of that network, so confirm the business unit, buying team and route relevant to your product rather than treating one network number as universal coverage. It is a better prospect for retail-ready grocery, drinks and impulse products than for products designed only for restaurant kitchens. Lead with expected rate of sale, retailer margin, promotional plan and distribution requirements.

### 4. Booker Group

[Booker](https://www.booker.co.uk/) supplies independent retailers, caterers and small businesses through a [nationwide network of more than 200 branches](https://www.booker.co.uk/catering), alongside delivery and online ordering. Brands should distinguish between Booker or Makro wholesale, a symbol-group opportunity and other group logistics or retail routes because these are separate commercial decisions. No public supplier application was verified during this review, so identify the relevant buying route before presenting the company as open to a new-product submission.

### 5. JJ Food Service

[JJ Foodservice](https://www.jjfoodservice.com/content/content-why-jjfoodservice-our-story) serves restaurants, caterers and other food businesses through nationwide delivery or collection from 14 branches. Its broad range includes food, drink, packaging and cleaning products. The official [Supply Us page](https://www.jjfoodservice.com/content/supply-us) gives prospective suppliers a direct purchasing contact and registration route. Confirm delivery days for the target postcode and whether the buying team expects national or branch-level demand.

### 6. Castell Howell Foods

[Castell Howell Foods](https://www.castellhowellfoods.co.uk/) is a family-run foodservice wholesaler based in Wales. Its published [six-depot network](https://www.castellhowellfoods.co.uk/en/what-we-do/partnering-with-us/delivery-network) covers Wales and English regions including Bristol and the South West, Chester and the North West, and the West Midlands; exact delivery reach still needs a postcode check. Its regional identity can be useful for locally sourced or differentiated products, but suppliers should still present operational capacity, margin and launch demand. The public site provides general contact details rather than a verified supplier application.

### 7. Creed Foodservice

[Creed Foodservice](https://www.creedfoodservice.co.uk/) is part of Kitwave Wholesale Group and leads its foodservice division. It publishes nationwide coverage from distribution centres in Cheltenham, Ilkeston and High Wycombe and serves sectors including hospitality, education and care. Creed’s [Kitwave supplier opportunity hub](https://about.creedfoodservice.co.uk/supplier-opportunities/) describes brand-activation options for suppliers working with a Kitwave Group buyer. It is not a public listing application, and no public intake form was verified.

### 8. Henderson Foodservice

[Henderson Foodservice](https://www.henderson-foodservice.com/about), part of the Henderson Group, delivers across Ireland from four regional depots and has separate Northern Ireland and Republic of Ireland contacts. Its Northern Ireland reach makes it relevant to brands treating that market as a distinct route-to-market decision. The official [contact page](https://www.henderson-foodservice.com/contact-us) includes instructions for prospective suppliers. Check the contracting entity, applicable labelling and import route rather than assuming a Great Britain agreement automatically covers Northern Ireland.

### 9. Philip Dennis Foodservice

[Philip Dennis Foodservice](https://www.philipdennis.co.uk/) is a family-owned catering and foodservice wholesaler covering the Southwest, Oxfordshire and the Midlands. Its range includes butchery, fish, frozen, chilled, ambient, drinks and non-food products. The best pitch is specific to the regional foodservice accounts you can help it win, supported by reliable packs and production. Its public site shows supplier relationships but no open supplier application was verified.

### 10. Turner Price

[Turner Price](https://www.turner-price.com/) is a food and drink wholesaler serving customers across the Midlands and North of England. It [joined Caterfood Buying Group following an acquisition in July 2024](https://www.caterfoodbg.co.uk/caterfood-buying-group-further-strengthens-its-portfolio-with-the-acquisition-of-turner-price) and was described at that point as continuing to operate autonomously. Manufacturers should verify the current buying route, identify whether the relevant decision sits with Turner Price or the wider Caterfood group and frame the proposal around operator demand, margin and portfolio fit.

### 11. Savona Foodservice

[Savona Foodservice](https://www.savona.co.uk/) is an independent foodservice wholesaler with South West, Central and South East, and London locations. It is a regional alternative for brands whose launch plan does not require immediate national coverage. Savona says it can incorporate new suppliers, but no public application form was verified. Ask about delivery postcodes, product onboarding, minimum order expectations and the sales support expected from the supplier.

## Choosing the Right Partner

1. **Choose the channel first:** decide whether the product belongs in foodservice, independent retail, wholesale depots or several channels with different pack sizes.
2. **Map real coverage:** ask for postcode-level delivery reach and target-account overlap. “National” can still exclude routes or require regional onboarding.
3. **Check commercial fit:** compare margin, listing fees, minimum volumes, payment terms, returns, data access and promotional commitments.
4. **Confirm operating requirements:** document shelf life on delivery, pallet and case configuration, cold-chain needs, traceability, recall processes and service levels.
5. **Define ownership:** agree who owns retail or operator selling, forecasting, sampling, marketing and key-account introductions.
6. **Pilot before exclusivity:** use measurable target accounts, a review date and termination terms. Do not grant UK-wide exclusivity solely on a distributor’s claimed reach.

For a deeper route-to-market process, read our [UK food and beverage distributors guide](https://www.gourmetpro.co/blog/uk-food-beverage-distributors-guide/). Use the [distributor toolkit](https://www.gourmetpro.co/resources/distributor-toolkit/) to turn the comparison into a scored shortlist and structured outreach.

## FAQs for The Top 11 UK Food Distributors

### **Q1 - How do I find distributors for my products in the UK?**

Define your target channel, customer type, delivery territory and product requirements, then shortlist distributors whose published range and coverage match. Trade shows, wholesale depots, restaurant or retailer shelf checks and category-buyer referrals can reveal who already handles adjacent products. Approach the relevant category or procurement team with a concise trade pack and evidence of demand. For a UK search that moves beyond a directory, GourmetPro’s [distributor and partner search](https://www.gourmetpro.co/services/distributor-partner-search/) covers outreach, qualification, and negotiation support.

### **Q2 - Who is the top oriental food distributor in the UK?**

There is no objective single leader for every Asian category and UK channel. Specialists such as [M.A. Oriental Foods](https://maoriental.co.uk/) may be relevant, but compare cuisine focus, chilled or frozen capability, geographic reach, customer mix and willingness to build a new brand before choosing a partner.

### **Q3 - Who is the top fine food distributor in the UK?**

The answer depends on whether you need premium retail, hospitality or restaurant coverage. [Cress Co](https://www.thecressco.co.uk/) focuses on independent fine-food retail, while foodservice specialists serve different accounts. Request current customer-channel and territory evidence instead of relying on a general “top” label.

**Sources checked 14 September 2026:** official company pages linked throughout the article, plus the [Food & Drink Wholesale UK member list](https://www.fwd.co.uk/members) and [Country Range Group member list](https://countryrangegroup.com/our-members/). Coverage and supplier-route wording reflects the published pages available on that date and should be rechecked before outreach.
